user.title: Connect BOLOLO
user.description: Enter your app phone number without its country calling code. SMS is selected by default; submitting requests one code. Password login is also available. Setup retrieves bound devices and prefers LAN.

data.username: Phone number (email also supported for password login)

sms.title: Verify SMS code
sms.description: Enter your SMS code and submit. A supplied code is always verified. To resend, clear the code, select Resend and submit; wait at least 60 seconds between requests. If retrieving devices fails temporarily, submit again to continue.

captcha.title: Image verification
captcha.description:
Enter the characters in the image, not an SMS code. SMS is requested after image verification. The image and link expire after 5 minutes; restart setup if expired.

![Verification image]({captcha_image})

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the BOLOLO cloud. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The account, password or country code was rejected.
error.invalid_account: Enter a valid phone number and country calling code.
error.invalid_code: The code was rejected or expired. Check it or request another code.
error.code_required: Enter your SMS code or select Resend.
error.sms_cooldown: Wait at least 60 seconds after the previous SMS request.
error.sms_rate_limit: SMS requests are rate limited. Try again later.
error.invalid_captcha: The image code was rejected. Enter the characters from the new image.
error.expired_captcha: The image code expired. Enter the characters from the new image.
error.captcha_required: Enter the characters in the image.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in to the same BOLOLO account as this integration.

init.title: Connection settings
init.description: Choose a connection mode. Optionally select a device to override its LAN address or passcode. LAN-only mode uses the cached inventory without refreshing cloud account bindings.

device.title: {device}
device.description: The integration discovers addresses and obtains local passcodes automatically. An IPv4 override assists discovery; allow UDP 12414, 2415 and TCP 12416. Passcodes normally do not need to be entered. Leave a field blank to clear its override.

add_bottle.title: Add a bottle
add_bottle.description: Choose a P30 device. Keep the device powered on and stay beside it to complete weighing. Cloud access is required to save the bottle.

bottle_details.title: Bottle details
bottle_details.description: Choose a baby already created in the BOLOLO app and enter a bottle name (1–7 characters). Submitting starts bottle marking on the device.

bottle_empty_tray.title: Empty the weighing tray
bottle_empty_tray.description: Remove all objects from the water tray. Only select Confirm once the tray is empty. The device will tare the tray. Cancel resets bottle marking.

bottle_place.title: Place an empty bottle
bottle_place.description: Place an empty bottle on the tray and keep it still. Select Confirm to measure and mark the bottle. Do not use a bottle containing water.

data.confirm: The empty bottle is on the tray

bottle_result.title: Read the bottle result
bottle_result.description: Wait for the device to finish marking, then select Confirm to check its result. Checking again only reads status and does not repeat weighing. For a failed marking, cancel and start again.

bottle_save.title: Save bottle {name}
bottle_save.description: The device assigned bottle number {number}. Select Confirm to save this bottle to the selected baby. Automatic child-lock unlocking keeps its current setting. If saving fails, check the BOLOLO app before starting again.

error.bottle_invalid_device: Select an available supported P30 device.
error.bottle_cannot_connect: Unable to read BOLOLO data. Check the connection and try again.
error.bottle_invalid_name: Enter a bottle name of 1–7 characters.
error.bottle_invalid_baby: Choose a baby from the list.
error.bottle_reset_pending: The device has not confirmed clearing its previous bottle number. Wait, then submit again.
error.bottle_registration_rejected: The device rejected marking (duplicate weight or bottle limit). Cancel and check the BOLOLO app.
error.bottle_too_light: No bottle was detected, or it was too light. Cancel and try another empty bottle.
error.bottle_result_pending: The device has not returned a valid bottle number and weight. Wait, then check again.
error.bottle_save_unknown: Saving was not confirmed and will not be sent again. Check the BOLOLO app, then cancel to reset the device.

abort.bottle_integration_unavailable: Load the BOLOLO integration before adding a bottle.
abort.bottle_cloud_required: Bottle saving requires cloud access. Switch to Automatic or Cloud only mode first.
abort.bottle_no_device: No available supported P30 device was found.
abort.bottle_no_baby: Create a baby in the BOLOLO app before adding a bottle.
abort.bottle_reset_failed: The device reset was not confirmed. Check bottle marking on the device or in the BOLOLO app.
abort.bottle_command_uncertain: The device command was not confirmed and was not repeated. Check the device or BOLOLO app before restarting bottle marking.
